assumptions: State IDs and one continent are model scope identifiers, not actual map IDs or a campaign.
The universe contains exactly the five listed state scopes in every case; all country scopes, flags, external classifier predicates, adjacency, arrays and control are explicit.
Unit weights represent the declared equal-choice projection of unchanged random_state sampling, not a source tuning value or native RNG proof.
External scripted country-classifier branches are explicitly false; actual-nonhuman ZIN and human Special Chaos REV follow the unchanged shared source tag branches.
Neighbor usability is derived from the unchanged source predicate without population, actual-nonhuman or CXT narrowing.
The source evaluator checks that actual routing limits select the same pool as the projection in every supplied case.
This is one conditional selection, with no simulated cadence, transitions, seeds, effects, fragmentation count, F04/F14 behavior or in-game acceptance.
The API requires a cadence; a nominal one-day timer is identical on both sides solely to encode one conditional draw. No native timing or cadence conclusion is claimed.
The neighbor-pool mode is a derived fixture input computed from the complete finite world and checked against both actual-source predicates. It is equal in both phases for every supplied case.
